it: \rLì dentro non c'è niente di valore.

id: \bOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.
en: \bOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.
it: \bOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto.

id: \bWe need to find the Pokémon that can use this.
en: \bWe need to find the Pokémon that can use this.
it: \bDobbiamo trovare il Pokémon che può usare questo.

id: \rLillie: This place is always hard to visit.
en: \rLillie: This place is always hard to visit.

id: \bI'm been studying how Alolan forms work on certain Pokémon. Would you happen to have a Pichu?
en: \bI'm been studying how Alolan forms work on certain Pokémon. Would you happen to have a Pichu?
it: \bSto studiando come funzionano le forme di Alola su certi Pokémon. Per caso hai un Pichu?

id: \bWant to trade it for my Togedemaru?
en: \bWant to trade it for my Togedemaru?

id: \bFaba: Welcome to Aether Paradise. The rest of the class arrived earlier and are touring the building right now.
en: \bFaba: Welcome to Aether Paradise. The rest of the class arrived earlier and are touring the building right now.
it: \bVicio: Benvenuto al Paradiso Aether. Il resto della classe è arrivato prima e ora sta visitando l'edificio.

id: \bMy name is Faba. I was told to check out this rare Pokémon you own.
en: \bMy name is Faba. I was told to check out this rare Pokémon you own.
it: \bMi chiamo Vicio. Mi è stato detto di esaminare questo raro Pokémon che possiedi.

id: \bI'll run some tests on it. See if you can't find your class.
en: \bI'll run some tests on it. See if you can't find your class.
it: \bFarò qualche test su di lui. Tu vedi se riesci a trovare la tua classe.

id: \bFaba: I did it! I managed to use that Cosmog to summon an Ultra Beast! No one before me has been this amazing!
en: \bFaba: I did it! I managed to use that Cosmog to summon an Ultra Beast! No one before me has been this amazing!
it: \bVicio: Ce l'ho fatta! Sono riuscito a usare quel Cosmog per evocare un'Ultracreatura! Nessuno prima di me è stato così straordinario!

id: \bGladion: It's attacking Mother. We have to slow it down!
en: \bGladion: It's attacking Mother. We have to slow it down!
it: \bIridio: Sta attaccando la mamma. Dobbiamo rallentarlo!

id: \rLusamine: Kids, stay back! I'll be fine. Seek help!
en: \rLusamine: Kids, stay back! I'll be fine. Seek help!
it: \rSamina: Ragazzi, state indietro! Starò bene. Cercate aiuto!

id: \bGladion: Lillie I think I know where we can go to find mother. We need to head to Poni Island. Take Nebby with you, it can help.
en: \bGladion: Lillie I think I know where we can go to find mother. We need to head to Poni Island. Take Nebby with you, it can help.
it: \bIridio: Lylia, credo di sapere dove possiamo andare a cercare la mamma. Dobbiamo andare sull'Isola di Poni. Porta Nebby con te, può aiutarci.

id: \bFaba: You ruined it! I was going to research it!
en: \bFaba: You ruined it! I was going to research it!

id: \bKiawe: I found this more enjoyable than I thought I would.
en: \bKiawe: I found this more enjoyable than I thought I would.
it: \bKiawe: Mi è piaciuto più di quanto pensassi.

id: This ball contain a Type: Null. Would you like to take it?
en: This ball contain a Type: Null. Would you like to take it?
it: Questa Ball contiene un Tipo Zero. Vuoi prenderlo?
\bPer favore, evita la stanza della signora Samina.

id: Rotom: Hello there \PN. Good to see you.
en: Rotom: Hello there \PN. Good to see you.

id: \rMallow: I hope Lillie is doing okay.
en: \rMallow: I hope Lillie is doing okay.

id: \rLillie: We have to go after her.
en: \rLillie: We have to go after her.

id: \rLusamine: Oh, I'm sorry I couldn't join your tour. I'm just too busy.
en: \rLusamine: Oh, I'm sorry I couldn't join your tour. I'm just too busy.
it: \rSamina: Oh, mi dispiace non essermi potuta unire alla vostra visita. Sono troppo impegnata.

id: \rLusamine: Oh, hello there. Please take full advantage of the facilities.
en: \rLusamine: Oh, hello there. Please take full advantage of the facilities.
it: \rSamina: Oh, salve. Approfitta pure di tutte le strutture.

id: \rBurnet: Hello \PN. You're living with Kukui, aren't you?
en: \rBurnet: Hello \PN. You're living with Kukui, aren't you?

id: \rMy name is Burnet. I focus on the relationship between Pokémon and other dimensions.
en: \rMy name is Burnet. I focus on the relationship between Pokémon and other dimensions.
it: \rMi chiamo Burnet. Studio il rapporto tra i Pokémon e le altre dimensioni.

id: \bFaba: Good, there you are. My research shows it's powerful and has the ability to use Teleport. I'll inform you if there's anything else I can find about it.
en: \bFaba: Good, there you are. My research shows it's powerful and has the ability to use Teleport. I'll inform you if there's anything else I can find about it.
it: \bVicio: Bene, eccoti. Dalle mie ricerche risulta che è potente e sa usare Teletrasporto. Ti informerò se scopro qualcos'altro su di lui.

id: \rLillie: So I guess that's the whole tour. I'm sorry my mother was too busy to give it but I hope I did okay.
en: \rLillie: So I guess that's the whole tour. I'm sorry my mother was too busy to give it but I hope I did okay.
it: \rLylia: Ecco, direi che la visita è finita. Mi dispiace che mia madre fosse troppo impegnata per guidarla, ma spero di essermela cavata.

id: \bKukui: You did great Lillie! Ah and there's \PN. Bit late, aren't you cousin? I'm sure you were busy studying your new friend.
en: \bKukui: You did great Lillie! Ah and there's \PN. Bit late, aren't you cousin? I'm sure you were busy studying your new friend.
it: \bKukui: Sei stata bravissima, Lylia! Ah, ecco \PN. Un po' in ritardo, eh, cugino? Scommetto che eri impegnato a studiare il tuo nuovo amico.

id: \bWell I hope everyone had fun. Let's head home.
en: \bWell I hope everyone had fun. Let's head home.
it: \bBene, spero che vi siate divertiti tutti. Torniamo a casa.

id: \rWelcome to Aether Paradise. Let me know if I can help with anything.
en: \rWelcome to Aether Paradise. Let me know if I can help with anything.
it: \rBenvenuto al Paradiso Aether. Fammi sapere se posso aiutarti in qualcosa.

id: \bKukui: There you are cousin. You missed the whole thing.
en: \bKukui: There you are cousin. You missed the whole thing.
it: \bKukui: Eccoti, cugino. Ti sei perso tutto.
